title: The Lord Declares His Will
description: The Lord Declares His Will in Tonic Solfa to BOYLSTON, doh is C: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 7 verses and a piano.
about: Isaac Watts wrote these words for his Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707), Book II, composed on divine subjects, hymn 120, headed “The law and gospel joined in scripture”.
Watts' hymns were printed without tunes and sung to any tune of their metre, Short Metre (6.6.8.6). This page sets the words to BOYLSTON; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: The Lord de-clares his will, And keeps the world in awe; A-midst the smoke on Si-nai's hill Breaks out his fie-ry law.

lines: And keeps the world in awe;
Amidst the smoke on Sinai's hill
Sends down the gospel of his grace,
The pity of his melting heart,
The arms of grace are treasur'd here,
Obey the statutes of the Lord,
Where wrath and lightning guard the page,

source: Isaac Watts, Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707)
licence: Public domain: Isaac Watts died in 1748.
credits: Words by Isaac Watts (1674–1748), public domain; set to BOYLSTON by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
